entities.summary: Germany is a sovereign nation in Western Europe, Europe. Its capital is Berlin. Official languages include German. Government: Federal parliamentary republic. Population: approximately 84.5 million. Area: 357,114 km². Comprehensive index for Germany covering Germanic tribes (Arminius/Teutoburg Forest 9 CE), Frankish Empire/Charlemagne, Holy Roman Empire (962-1806, 'First Reich'), Hanseatic League, Reformation (Martin Luther 1517, Wittenberg), Thirty Years' War (1618-48, ~8M dead), Enlightenment (Kant, Goethe), Napoleonic Wars, Congress of Vienna, Revolutions 1848, Bismarck unification 1871 (Second Reich), Kaiser Wilhelm II, WWI (1914-18, 2M dead), Weimar Republic, Hitler/Nazi Germany (Third Reich 1933-45), WWII (1939-45, 7M German dead), Holocaust/Shoah (6M Jews murdered), division BRD/DDR (1949-90), Berlin Wall (1961-89), reunification 1990, EU engine, and economic powerhouse.
